label: PF Backlog 427
title: A2: capability registry + entitlement-at-boundary + asymmetric licensing
body: [A2] Capability registry; entitlement checks at execution boundaries; asymmetric license (public-key verify; private key never ships).

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/artifact_registry.py, core/capability_bridge.py, core/capability_packs.py, core/change_registry.py

missing: Reconciliation with BI-PF-0352 (ownership of license format/keys)
Signature algorithm and license document format
Scope of execution boundaries to gate
context_review.reason: Rich reuse surface exists (licensing, capability bridge/packs, execution contract, two tenant endpoints, six config modules). Missing items are design and ownership decisions, not unknown technical territory; implementation can begin once the BI-PF-0352 overlap is assigned.

brief.problem: Commercial editions need capability gating and licensing that cannot be tampered with or leak the private key.
brief.what_adds: A2 — capability registry + entitlement checks at execution boundaries + asymmetric licensing (public-key verify; the private key never ships).
brief.why: Enforce edition entitlements at runtime and protect licenses from forgery.
brief.who_feels: PF platform maintainers, workers, and customers.

objective: A2 — capability registry + entitlement checks at execution boundaries + asymmetric licensing (public-key verify; the private key never ships).
acceptance_criteria: a license issued and verified via public key unlocks entitled capabilities
approach: Register capabilities; check entitlements at execution boundaries (fail-closed); verify licenses with a public key; the private key stays in the signing environment only.
verification: a license issued and verified via public key unlocks entitled capabilities

api_impact.reason: no API surface declared in backend_capability
